observations.why: Directive cadence imposed by a position-holder: a command that schedules a recurring obligation, enacting rank-based authority over the team's calendar.

evidence.quote:

observations.why: A definitional decree that reframes an operational gap as non-possession — the speaker legislates what counts as having a capability, a rank-based move dressed as an aphorism.
Recorded cadence entry ratifying the directive into a standing schedule — the authority-ranking move of setting a recurring obligation, now inscribed as a referenceable artifact.
Naming a single accountable party assigns rank-based responsibility — the authority-ranking move of designating who holds the obligation.
